tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring honey on a plane?

travelTips: Honey is a liquid/gel and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Carry-on jars must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.question: Is honey allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Honey is restricted in carry-on luggage. Honey is a liquid/gel and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Carry-on jars must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.question: Can you pack honey in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Honey is allowed in checked bags. Honey is allowed in checked baggage in any quantity.
